g.text: An Integrated Framework for Species Distribution Modelling and Dynamic Ocean Management

text.tspan: Figure 1 | Conceptual framework and methodological workflow of the SEACAST approach.
Sequential execution stages comprising (01) multi-source data acquisition,
(02) spatiotemporal data pre-processing and canonical grid alignment,
(03) parallel species distribution modelling across three distinct algorithm paradigms (MaxEnt, Random Forest, and GLM), (04) rigorous spatial validation,
(06) dynamic ocean management (DOM) spatial zoning and route optimization, and (07) field ground-truth validation and operational research outputs.
